data: Dedication to the Genius of Lilybaeum
21 BCE — 193 CE, due to the status as municipium rather than colonia
Seen by Gualtherus in the church of St. Thomas of Canterbury, i.e. the Duomo, in the steps of the chapel of S. Maria de Hyrdia, but not seen since.
